mapper.select: SELECT n.tenant_id,n.fingerprint,n.recovered_at FROM (SELECT i.tenant_id,i.fingerprint,MAX(e.occurred_at) AS recovered_at FROM incident i JOIN alert_event e ON e.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND e.alert_event_id=i.recovery_event_id WHERE i.status='RECOVERED' GROUP BY i.tenant_id,i.fingerprint) n WHERE 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident active WHERE active.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND active.fingerprint=n.fingerprint AND active.status='ACTIVE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_event pending WHERE pending.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND pending.fingerprint=n.fingerprint AND pending.incident_id IS NULL AND pending.event_type='FIRING' AND pending.occurred_at>n.recovered_at AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident known JOIN alert_event first_event ON first_event.tenant_id=known.tenant_id AND first_event.alert_event_id=known.first_event_id WHERE known.tenant_id=pending.tenant_id AND known.fingerprint=pending.fingerprint AND first_event.alert_cycle_ref=pending.alert_cycle_ref)) ORDER BY n.recovered_at,n.tenant_id,n.fingerprint LIMIT 100
